title: Deterministic Hardware and Enterprise Identity Resolution
acceptance_criteria: The sensor MUST resolve a deterministic serial number, asset ID, hostname, and enterprise management flag. When running on unmanaged hardware, it MUST generate and persist a reproducible fallback device UUID.
verifying_tests: test_device_telemetry.test.js::Resolves enterprise device attributes dynamically
test_device_telemetry.test.js::Deterministic identity resolution

title: Dynamic Hardware Telemetry Inspection
acceptance_criteria: The sensor MUST inspect CPU utilization, memory metrics, display resolution, battery level, and network interface IP addresses without throwing unhandled exceptions.
verifying_tests: test_device_telemetry.test.js::Hardware CPU, Memory, Storage, Display & Battery inspection

title: Wi-Fi RF Channel and Band Computation
acceptance_criteria: The sensor MUST accurately compute Wi-Fi channels across 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, and 6 GHz spectrum bands from RF center frequency in MHz.
verifying_tests: test_device_telemetry.test.js::Wi-Fi RF frequency to channel conversion
test_device_telemetry.test.js::getActiveWifiTelemetry retrieves active BSSID & RSSI

title: Signal Percentage to RSSI dBm Mapping
acceptance_criteria: The sensor MUST map linear 0-100% signal strength indicators to approximate RSSI values between -100 dBm and -50 dBm when raw dBm is absent.
verifying_tests: test_device_telemetry.test.js::Signal percentage to RSSI dBm conversion

title: Offline Telemetry Queue Buffering and Peek
acceptance_criteria: When the network or CMP is unreachable, telemetry reports MUST be enqueued in an offline buffer with FIFO retrieval order and zero data corruption.
verifying_tests: test_indexed_db.test.js::Enqueue and Peek batch with fallback memory queue

title: FIFO Backpressure Eviction
acceptance_criteria: When the offline buffer reaches maximum configured capacity (maxRecords), the oldest telemetry records MUST be evicted to prevent unbounded memory or storage growth.
verifying_tests: test_indexed_db.test.js::FIFO backpressure eviction at max records

title: WebRTC VoIP MOS Calculation (ITU-T G.107)
acceptance_criteria: Given latency (RTT), jitter, and packet loss, the sensor MUST calculate an accurate Mean Opinion Score bounded between 1.0 and 4.5 and map to standard ITU-T quality grades.
verifying_tests: test_mos_calculator.test.js::Excellent Toll Quality
test_mos_calculator.test.js::Good Quality (Standard Classroom Call)

title: Captive Portal and Walled Garden Interception Detection
acceptance_criteria: The sensor MUST detect HTTP 204 responses as clear internet and any redirect, HTTP 200/302 splash pages as a captive portal intercept, capturing the redirect URL.
verifying_tests: test_wifi_diagnostics.test.js::Identifies genuine HTTP 204 as open internet
test_wifi_diagnostics.test.js::Identifies HTTP 302 redirect / HTTP 200 splash page as captive portal

title: Wi-Fi Sticky Client and AP Flapping Detection
acceptance_criteria: The analyzer MUST flag sticky client behavior when signal is weak on 2.4 GHz (<= -72 dBm) and identify AP thrashing/flapping when 3 or more BSSID transitions occur within 60 seconds.
verifying_tests: test_wifi_diagnostics.test.js::Evaluates signal classification correctly
test_wifi_diagnostics.test.js::Detects Sticky Client on 2.4 GHz
test_wifi_diagnostics.test.js::Detects AP Flapping / Thrashing

title: UI Configuration Schema Validation and Sanitization
acceptance_criteria: Settings inputs for CMP URL, probe intervals (15-3600), max buffer records (50-10000), and campus IDs MUST be strictly validated and sanitized before persistence.
verifying_tests: test_ui_form_validation.test.js::Rejects empty CMP URL
test_ui_form_validation.test.js::Normalizes scheme and strips trailing slash on URL

title: Local Default Gateway Reachability and RTT Probe
acceptance_criteria: The sensor MUST derive the local gateway IP address from the client IPv4 address and probe its reachability and round-trip time (RTT) to isolate local subnet issues from upstream WAN outages.
verifying_tests: test_gateway_dns_probes.test.js::Derives gateway IP correctly from IPv4 address
test_gateway_dns_probes.test.js::Handles reachable local gateway successfully
test_gateway_dns_probes.test.js::Gracefully reports unreachable gateway on timeout

title: Dual-Stack DNS Resolution Benchmark
acceptance_criteria: The sensor MUST execute concurrent DNS resolution benchmarks comparing public DoH providers (Google/Cloudflare) against the local DNS stack to detect latency degradation and DNS filter interception.
verifying_tests: test_gateway_dns_probes.test.js::Resolves DoH successfully
test_gateway_dns_probes.test.js::Resolves Local DNS successfully
test_gateway_dns_probes.test.js::Evaluates dual-stack health and flags local DNS timeout

title: Micro-Burst Downlink Bandwidth and Bufferbloat Probe
acceptance_criteria: The sensor MUST perform low-overhead micro-chunk downloads to measure downlink throughput in Mbps and concurrent loaded RTT delta to grade bufferbloat latency spikes (A through F).
verifying_tests: test_bandwidth_bufferbloat.test.js::Computes downlink throughput and Grade A bufferbloat
test_bandwidth_bufferbloat.test.js::Correctly grades high bufferbloat latency spikes
test_bandwidth_bufferbloat.test.js::Gracefully handles download timeout or network failure

title: EdTech Filter and Student Safety Agent Diagnostics
acceptance_criteria: The sensor MUST detect installed K-12 filtering agents (Securly, Lightspeed, Blocksi, GoGuardian, Linewize, ContentKeeper, Cisco Umbrella), probe cloud edge inspection gateway latency, flag multi-agent collisions, and evaluate filter latency overhead.
verifying_tests: test_edtech_filter.test.js::Probes individual filter cloud endpoint successfully
test_edtech_filter.test.js::Handles probe timeout gracefully
test_edtech_filter.test.js::Evaluates healthy filter cloud latency and detects fastest provider
test_edtech_filter.test.js::Flags multi-agent collision when multiple filters are detected
test_edtech_filter.test.js::Detects high filtering proxy overhead latency degradation
test_edtech_filter.test.js::Flags CLOUD_UNREACHABLE when all filter endpoints fail

title: District LMS Safe-List Pass-Through and SSL MITM Handshake Verification
acceptance_criteria: The sensor MUST verify that educational platforms (Google Classroom, Canvas LMS, Clever SSO, Kahoot) are reachable through the filtering proxy without false-positive blocks, and validate TLS/SSL inspection certificate handshake integrity.
verifying_tests: test_edtech_filter.test.js::All educational endpoints reachable
test_edtech_filter.test.js::Detects blocked or timing out educational tools
test_edtech_filter.test.js::Detects valid TLS handshake and flags MITM cert failure
test_edtech_filter.test.js::Flags CLASSROOM_BLOCKED and SSL_INSPECTION_FAILED statuses

title: Real Chromium Extension Lifecycle and Popup DOM Rendering
acceptance_criteria: The extension MUST load cleanly inside Chromium without service worker crashes, bind diagnostic UI components in popup.html, and execute a live on-demand sweep without unhandled promise rejections.
verifying_tests: test_chromium_e2e.test.js::Boots MV3 Extension and Executes Live Diagnostic Sweep
